results.title: Target SDK Version not detected
results.description: Could not detect targetSdkVersion. New apps in 2025+ need to target API 35 (Android 15).
results.fix: Set targetSdkVersion in expo.android.targetSdkVersion or in android/app/build.gradle.

results.title: No advertising SDK / Advertising ID detected
File storage SDK detected
results.description: The app accesses device storage. Declare in the Data Safety Section if it collects or reads user files.
results.fix: In the Data Safety Section, declare 'Photos and videos' or 'Files and docs' depending on the content accessed.

results.title: No Data Safety documentation in the repository
results.description: It is good practice to keep internal documentation of what was declared in the Google Play Data Safety Section.
results.fix: Create docs/data-safety.md documenting the data collected. Use the template in templates/data-safety-form.md.
